zh: R0.73X 的 explicit exterior tails 与 positive-scale size 边界
en: R0.73X explicit exterior tails and positive-scale size boundary

zh: R0.73X 的价值在于把一个含混的 local remainder 问题拆成可独立攻击的三层：direct Gaussian velocity/pressure-source transport、algebraic harmonic pressure tail，以及 signed payment 到 positive size 的 coercivity bridge。 第一层与第二层现在有 exact definitions、scale audit、positive-scale size proof 与 independent readback。这样，后续若提出更强 theorem，就不能再把 pressure nonlocality 或 zero-scale endpoint 隐藏在“lower-order error”里。 同样重要的是，本节关闭了两个精确定义的错误方向：fixed probe class 的 amplitude-independent quadratic absorption，以及没有 exterior input 的 velocity-only functional tail estimate。 仍未闭合的不是另一个 algebraic identity，而是式 (1.7)：怎样从 signed information 得到能进入 CKN/Koch--Tataru interface 的 positive smallness， 同时保留 compact cutoff、harmonic pressure 与 suitable-weak defect。 因此这一节是 rigorous boundary result，而不是 regularity theorem，更不是 Clay problem 的完成比例。
en: The value of R0.73X is that it decomposes an ambiguous local remainder problem into three independently attackable layers: direct Gaussian velocity/pressure-source transport, an algebraic harmonic pressure tail, and a coercivity bridge from signed payment to positive size. The first and second layers now have exact definitions, a scale audit, a positive-scale size proof, and an independent readback. Any subsequent stronger theorem can therefore no longer hide pressure nonlocality or the zero-scale endpoint inside a “lower-order error.” Equally importantly, this section closes two precisely defined false directions: amplitude-independent quadratic absorption for a fixed probe class, and a velocity-only functional tail estimate with no exterior input. What remains unclosed is not another algebraic identity but equation (1.7): how to derive positive smallness suitable for the CKN/Koch--Tataru interface from signed information while retaining a compact cutoff, harmonic pressure, and a suitable-weak defect. This section is therefore a rigorous boundary result, not a regularity theorem and still less a completion percentage for the Clay problem.

zh: R0.73X 的主张边界
en: Claim boundary for R0.73X

zh: R0.73Y 应直接攻击 signed-to-absolute bridge，而不是再扩充同类 identity。 优先顺序是： 固定真正 compact cutoff，判断 full unsigned core 是否存在 non-circular absorption；若 absorption 失败，构造满足更接近 NSE pressure compatibility 的 obstruction；分离可由 local energy 缩小的 Gaussian row 与必须额外假设的 algebraic pressure row；研究 weighted tent endpoint 是否需要 cancellation beyond the pointwise majorant；任何 regularity claim 之前，先证明与已知 CKN/Lin/Vasseur/Kwon criterion 的严格 implication。 任意初值全局正则性与 Clay 保持 OPEN。
en: R0.73Y should attack the signed-to-absolute bridge directly instead of adding more identities of the same type. The priority order is: fix a genuinely compact cutoff and determine whether the full unsigned core admits non-circular absorption; if absorption fails, construct an obstruction satisfying something closer to NSE pressure compatibility; separate the Gaussian row that local energy can make small from the algebraic pressure row that requires an additional assumption; study whether the weighted tent endpoint requires cancellation beyond the pointwise majorant; and, before any regularity claim, prove a strict implication to a known CKN/Lin/Vasseur/Kwon criterion. Global regularity for arbitrary initial data and the Clay problem remain OPEN.

zh: 本页保留 R0.61 到 R0.73X 的全部 140 个节点。R0.61–R0.69W 从约化递推走到严格环带排除；R0.70A–R0.71Z 检查移动尺度、临界账本、内部 entry 与 complete-root 边界；R0.72A–R0.73B 处理 strong coupling、critical log、碰撞几何与完整线性 Fourier--Leray 行；R0.73C–I 依次处理冻结 Rayleigh 不稳定、黏性谱簇持续、固定正半平面传递、移动剖面增益、非线性相对放大、平面固定距离偏离与零窗口作用量边界。R0.73J 认证无黏连续谱支，R0.73K 闭合参数一致的黏性 rank-one 谱支，R0.73L 把冻结谱支升级为真实非自治 selected action；R0.73M 再用完整 action 指定种子，并在固定物理时刻闭合二维非线性固定距离偏离。背景随 \(\Lambda\) 改变，轨道留在精确二维不变子空间；prefactor 极限、两项 WKB、固定背景、横向三维、奇性与 Clay 没有被外推。 R0.73M 证明：当 \(\Lambda\to\infty\) 且背景随之改变时，按完整作用量 缩小的平面扰动可以在固定时刻保持固定阶输出。R0.73N 补上固定成员审计： 任意共存强解满足有限累积应变控制；平面扰动全局满足 \(L^2\) 稳定估计； 足够小的全三维 \(H^3\) 扰动落在正的全局强解稳定管内。因此，R0.73M 中的量词顺序不能交换为一个固定背景上的任意小输入、固定距离逃逸。 R0.73O 关闭了已知全局无强迫背景上的 \(H^3\)-小扰动不稳定路线：每条轨道最终衰减，累积 \(H^4\) 作用量有限，并有一个对所有起始时刻有效的正稳定半径。强迫对照保留无限累积应变，并由平面方向给出全局光滑、初始 \(H^3\) 趋零而输出固定 \(L^2\) 逃逸的见证。 R0.73P 关闭了固定全局强轨道周围的临界稳定与带限输入接口：临界管对所有起始时刻有效，\(N^{-1/2}\) 指数对范数转移精确，并允许 \(L^2\) 趋零而 \(H^3\) 发散的光滑扰动。能量球内所有弱分支在共同延迟后正则并相对参考轨道同步；不能跨越的部分是此前的早期弱区间。 这一节用周期 Stokes--HLS 双线性估计和有限 Volterra 递推，构造了一个全起点统一的临界热流稳定管。精确 Fourier 族证明它加入了旧 \(H^{1/2}\) 管之外的光滑安全数据；裸 Kato 上确界则被一个时间端点反例阻断。whole-space Besov 开放性属于已知文献，Clay 结论仍开放。 我把 R0.73R 的当前价值评为“可靠的桥接引理与反例工具”，而不是高水平正则性主定理。可保留之处是：分层拆开能量、加法几何与高阶相位；给出有限 Fourier 数据可复算的严格证书；用同谱确定性族证明二次能谱不足。 本节真正完成的是三件较窄但可用的工作。 限定式碰撞检索没有发现与“标量能量密度自相关 \(A Q\) + 两个精确非自治见证”完全相同的打包，但有限检索不是新颖性或优先权证明。本站只把它称为可审计的本地综合。 我对 R0.73U 的价值判断是：它没有解决全局正则性，但把 R0.73T 的两个信息缺口分开了。 这条路线的真正门槛不是再写一个高阶恒等式，而是从能量类获得新的、非循环的符号控制。这个门槛目前仍未跨过。
en: This page retains all 140 nodes from R0.61 through R0.73X. R0.61–R0.69W proceeds from reduced recursions to rigorous annular exclusion; R0.70A–R0.71Z examines moving scales, critical ledgers, interior entry, and complete-root boundaries; R0.72A–R0.73B treats strong coupling, critical log, collision geometry, and the complete linear Fourier--Leray row; R0.73C–I successively treats frozen Rayleigh instability, persistence of viscous spectral clusters, transfer in a fixed positive half-plane, moving-profile gain, nonlinear relative amplification, fixed-distance planar deviation, and the zero-window action boundary. R0.73J certifies the inviscid continuous spectral branch, R0.73K closes a parameter-consistent viscous rank-one spectral branch, and R0.73L upgrades the frozen spectral branch to a genuine nonautonomous selected action; R0.73M then specifies the seed using the full action and closes a two-dimensional nonlinear fixed-distance deviation at a fixed physical time. The background changes with \(\Lambda\), while the orbit remains in the exact two-dimensional invariant subspace; no extrapolation is made to the prefactor limit, two-term WKB, a fixed background, transverse three-dimensional behavior, singularity formation, or Clay. R0.73M proves that, when \(\Lambda\to\infty\) and the background changes accordingly, a planar perturbation reduced according to the full action can retain a fixed-order output at a fixed time. R0.73N adds the fixed-member audit: every coexisting strong solution satisfies finite cumulative-strain control; planar perturbations satisfy a global \(L^2\) stability estimate; and sufficiently small fully three-dimensional \(H^3\) perturbations lie in a positive global strong-solution stability tube. Therefore, the order of quantifiers in R0.73M cannot be exchanged for arbitrarily small input and fixed-distance escape on a single fixed background. R0.73O closes the \(H^3\)-small perturbation instability route on known global unforced backgrounds: every orbit eventually decays, the cumulative \(H^4\) action is finite, and a positive stability radius is valid for every starting time. The forced comparison retains infinite cumulative strain and supplies, in the planar direction, a globally smooth witness whose initial \(H^3\) norm tends to zero while its output undergoes a fixed \(L^2\) escape. R0.73P closes the critical-stability and band-limited-input interfaces around a fixed global strong orbit: the critical tube is valid for every starting time, the \(N^{-1/2}\) exponent is exact for norm transfer, and it permits smooth perturbations with \(L^2\) tending to zero while \(H^3\) diverges. All weak branches in the energy ball become regular after a common delay and synchronize relative to the reference orbit; the part that cannot be crossed is the preceding early weak interval. This section constructs a critical heat-flow stability tube uniform over all starting points using the periodic Stokes--HLS bilinear estimate and a finite Volterra recursion. An exact Fourier family proves that it adds smooth safe data outside the old \(H^{1/2}\) tube; a time-endpoint counterexample blocks the bare Kato supremum. Whole-space Besov openness is known in the literature, while the Clay conclusion remains open. I assess the present value of R0.73R as "a reliable bridging lemma and counterexample tool," not a high-level main regularity theorem. Its retained contributions are: separating energy, additive geometry, and higher-order phase by layers; providing a rigorous certificate reproducible from finite Fourier data; and using an isospectral deterministic family to prove that the quadratic energy spectrum is insufficient. This section completes three narrower but usable results. A bounded collision search found no package exactly matching "scalar energy-density autocorrelation \(A Q\) + two exact nonautonomous witnesses," but a finite search does not prove novelty or priority. The site describes it only as an auditable local synthesis. I assess R0.73U as not solving global regularity but separating the two information gaps in R0.73T. The real threshold on this route is not another higher-order identity, but new, non-circular sign control derived from the energy class. That threshold has not yet been crossed.

zh: R0.73X 的价值在于把一个含混的 local remainder 问题拆成可独立攻击的三层：direct Gaussian velocity/pressure-source transport、algebraic harmonic pressure tail，以及 signed payment 到 positive size 的 coercivity bridge。 第一层与第二层现在有 exact definitions、scale audit、positive-scale size proof 与 independent readback。这样，后续若提出更强 theorem，就不能再把 pressure nonlocality 或 zero-scale endpoint 隐藏在“lower-order error”里。 同样重要的是，本节关闭了两个精确定义的错误方向：fixed probe class 的 amplitude-independent quadratic absorption，以及没有 exterior input 的 velocity-only functional tail estimate。 仍未闭合的不是另一个 algebraic identity，而是式 (1.7)：怎样从 signed information 得到能进入 CKN/Koch--Tataru interface 的 positive smallness， 同时保留 compact cutoff、harmonic pressure 与 suitable-weak defect。 因此这一节是 rigorous boundary result，而不是 regularity theorem，更不是 Clay problem 的完成比例。 任意三维初值全局正则性与 Clay 保持 OPEN。
en: The value of R0.73X lies in splitting a vague local-remainder problem into three layers that can be attacked independently: direct Gaussian velocity/pressure-source transport, the algebraic harmonic-pressure tail, and the coercivity bridge from signed payment to positive size. The first and second layers now have exact definitions, a scale audit, a positive-scale size proof, and an independent readback. Consequently, any later stronger theorem can no longer hide pressure nonlocality or the zero-scale endpoint inside a "lower-order error." Equally important, this section closes two precisely defined false directions: amplitude-independent quadratic absorption for a fixed probe class, and a velocity-only functional tail estimate with no exterior input. The remaining gap is not another algebraic identity but (1.7): how to derive positive smallness suitable for the CKN/Koch--Tataru interface from signed information while retaining the compact cutoff, harmonic pressure, and suitable-weak defect. This section is therefore a rigorous boundary result, not a regularity theorem and still less a completion percentage for the Clay problem. Global regularity for arbitrary three-dimensional initial data and Clay remain OPEN.

zh: R0.73Y 应直接攻击 signed-to-absolute bridge，而不是再扩充同类 identity。 优先顺序是： 固定真正 compact cutoff，判断 full unsigned core 是否存在 non-circular absorption；若 absorption 失败，构造满足更接近 NSE pressure compatibility 的 obstruction；分离可由 local energy 缩小的 Gaussian row 与必须额外假设的 algebraic pressure row；研究 weighted tent endpoint 是否需要 cancellation beyond the pointwise majorant；任何 regularity claim 之前，先证明与已知 CKN/Lin/Vasseur/Kwon criterion 的严格 implication。
en: R0.73Y should attack the signed-to-absolute bridge directly instead of adding more identities of the same kind. The priority order is: fix a genuinely compact cutoff and determine whether the full unsigned core admits non-circular absorption; if absorption fails, construct an obstruction that more closely satisfies NSE pressure compatibility; separate the Gaussian row that can be made small by local energy from the algebraic pressure row that requires an additional hypothesis; investigate whether the weighted tent endpoint requires cancellation beyond the pointwise majorant; and, before any regularity claim, prove a rigorous implication to a known CKN/Lin/Vasseur/Kwon criterion.
